card.name: Founding and company-origin context
card.fires_on: Words and digits in text about founding, establishing or building organizations, such as company history, founding dates, or company details. It often fires on a digit inside a year or on a small word just before the company or building term.

modes.label: Years in founding history
modes.description: Digit or space inside a year in an institution's founding or history.

modes.label: Small words before company terms
modes.description: Linking words just before 'company', 'business' or similar organization words.

modes.label: Odd spots in history or business prose
modes.description: Words in passages on company ownership, castles or historical figures.
